title: Transpacific Industries Group Ltd - completed acquisition of part of the business of Allied Industrial Services Pty Ltd

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC published a Statement of Issues outlining preliminary competition concerns.

body_sections.Summary: Transpacific Industries Group Ltd has acquired part of the business of Allied Industrial Services Pty Ltd.
body_sections.Market definition: The acquisition was considered in the context of: -  the Sydney regional market for the supply of industrial cleaning services; - the national market for the supply of parts washers;  and - the national market for the supply of compaction bins.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC formed the view that the acquisition was unlikely to substantially lessen competition in the relevant markets due to a number of competitors who would be likely to constrain the merged firm.
